description: Ask Ahel to add an action the catalog does not have, when capability_search finds nothing that fits. Give the job in plain words, one example input, and the most the person would pay for one run. Asking again adds to the same request. Free; runs and charges nothing. NOT for: finding what exists, which is capability_search.

example_input.description: Optional: one example input, as text or an object (a domain, a profile URL, a name).

max_price_usd.description: Optional: the most you would pay for one call, in USD.

what.description: What you need done, in plain words: the job, not a provider name.

name: catalog_request
title: Ask for a missing action
